title: Lesson 13: One-Line Equations
learningGoals: Solve linear equations mentally with structure.
Use inverse operations with speed and clarity.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Open One-Line Equations with one fast mental-math hook and connect it to prior knowledge.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Recall what you already know about One-Step Equations.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Explain the rule behind One-Step Equations in simple language.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Repeat the rule for Two-Step Equations in your own words.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Model Two-Step Equations step by step on the board.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Watch the example and say the next step before it is revealed.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Guide the learner through Two-Step Equations with prompt-based support.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Solve a scaffolded example on Mental One-Line Solutions.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Shift to independent practice on Three-Step Equations across difficulty levels.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Answer independent questions on One-Step Equations.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Diagnose errors and reteach the exact step that broke down.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Explain the mistake and correct it.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Ask the learner to explain the shortcut before advancing.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Summarize the method for Three-Step Equations.
